data.description:
## Description
**What**: Extend plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-delta-test-quality.md (the build source) with a Tier 1 (assertion shape) dimension and a Tier 2 (articulation) dimension, including the REQUIRED predicate-listing scaffold and the anti-sycophancy prime, then regenerate the compiled plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-test-quality.md via build-review-agents.sh. Also assert the explicit descope: pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh and semgrep-rules/test-anti-patterns.yaml are NOT extended.
**Why**: The reviewer dimensions are the sole enforcement path for Rules 6/7 (review-only, no hooks). They consume the Rule 6 header schema.
**Scope**:
- IN: Tier 1 dimension (flag assertions on internal method names, private state, mock-invocation counts, source-grep patterns; require observable-output assertions); Tier 2 dimension cases (a) missing/malformed header, (b) tautological catches_regression_where, (c) predicate-listing scaffold for claim-vs-assertion disjointness, (d) catches_regression_where would not actually fail the test, (e) duplicate intent_id without orthogonal suffix; anti-sycophancy prime; build-review-agents.sh regeneration of the compiled agent; negative assertion that the two hook/semgrep files remain unextended.
- OUT: The synthetic-diff review validation run (draft-4); rule text in behavioral-testing-standard.md (draft-1).

## Done Definitions

- reviewer-delta-test-quality.md contains a Tier 1 (assertion shape) dimension that flags assertions targeting internal method names, private state, mock-invocation counts, or source-grep patterns and requires assertions on observable outputs ← Satisfies: sc-4
- reviewer-delta-test-quality.md contains a Tier 2 (articulation) dimension covering all five cases a through e, the predicate-listing scaffold, and the anti-sycophancy prime text ← Satisfies: sc-4
- running build-review-agents.sh regenerates code-reviewer-test-quality.md so the compiled agent contains the Tier 1 and Tier 2 dimension text ← Satisfies: sc-4
- pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh and semgrep-rules/test-anti-patterns.yaml contain no Rule 6 or Rule 7 enforcement logic, confirming review-only enforcement ← Satisfies: sc-8
- unit tests written and passing assert the Tier 1 and Tier 2 dimensions are present in the regenerated compiled agent ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations

- [Correctness] Tier 2(c) predicate-listing scaffold and the anti-sycophancy prime are weak defenses against LLM reviewer sycophancy on fluent headers; this is accepted residual risk per the epic Scenario Analysis.
- [Build] The compiled agent must be regenerated from the delta source via build-review-agents.sh; do not hand-edit the compiled code-reviewer-test-quality.md.
- [Descope] sc-8 is a negative constraint; the DD asserts absence of enforcement logic in the two named files rather than presence of a feature.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a code reviewer, I want Tier 1 (assertion shape) and Tier 2 (articulation) dimensions in the test-quality reviewer, so that change-detector and mis-articulated tests are flagged at review
